title: CLIENT_ADDED payload
description: A further client key registered for the principal, with its scheme tag and public key.

via.description: key_id of the connected client that authorised the addition

scheme.description: Scheme tag of the registered public key.

public_key.description: Hex public key: 32 bytes (ed25519) or a 65-byte SEC1 uncompressed point (ecdsa-p256).
